intro.text: A town with an imperial garrison about an hour north of the Luth-Davn Canal, two weeks from Luthadel by canal, near the Arguois caverns.

description.text: Holstep lies about an hour north of the Luth-Davn Canal, a two-week canal journey from Luthadel. The Arguois caverns are nearby, and Valtroux is about three days' march away.

items.text: On Yeden's orders, part of the skaa rebel army hidden in the Arguois caverns made a night attack on the Holstep Garrison. Around two thousand, Demoux among them, refused, thinking it a mistake. The other five thousand beat the garrison of about a thousand, though the fight was harder than expected.

A messenger escaped to Valtroux, whose five-thousand-strong garrison marched at once while the Luthadel Garrison followed. The tired rebels were overwhelmed and no prisoners were taken; the officers' heads, Yeden's among them, were set on spears by the road. Only those who had stayed in the caverns survived.
The defeat was a serious blow to Kelsier's plans, and he blamed himself for the rebels' overconfidence.
